about: <JJJJ> of a conserved U(1) current in 3d: upstream's JJJJ3d (stress-tensors-3d jt branch, Bounds/JJJJ3d.hs, 7 crossing equations), the bound JJJJ2025.jjjj3dBound builds. Channels are the spatial parity sectors of the exchanged operators. Objectives: feasibility, with or without fixed (lambda_JJT_ward, lambda_JJT); ope_bound, the upper or lower bound on the external T term along lambda.
